title: EdPickup
description: Automatically adds broken block drops directly to your inventory. Lightweight and customizable auto-pickup for Spigot/Paper servers.
body:
## 🎉 Initial Release

**EdPickup** is a lightweight auto-pickup plugin for Spigot/Paper servers.

### ✨ Features
- Automatically adds broken block drops directly to your inventory
- Supports containers (chests, shulkers, barrels) – items inside are also picked up
- Fully configurable messages, sounds, and title notifications
- Per-player toggle with `/edpickup` (aliases: `/autopickup`, `/ap`)
- Force-enable option for entire server
- Persistent player preferences across server restarts
- Permission-based subcommands (`edpickup.on`, `edpickup.off`, `edpickup.toggle`, `edpickup.help`, `edpickup.reload`)

### 🖥️ Compatibility
- Minecraft versions: **1.18 – 1.21**
- Server software: Spigot, Paper, Purpur

### 📥 Commands
- `/edpickup on` – Enable auto-pickup
- `/edpickup off` – Disable auto-pickup
- `/edpickup toggle` – Toggle auto-pickup
- `/edpickup help` – Show help
- `/edpickup reload` – Reload config (admin)

### 🔧 Permissions
- `edpickup.use` – Allows basic commands (default: true)
- `edpickup.reload` – Allows reload (default: op)

### 📄 Configuration
All messages, delays, title settings, and force-enable are customizable in `config.yml`.

Enjoy! 🚀
